Vinicius Jr.why: Vinicius Jr is trigger-happy and fearless, the keeper's gloves are smoking! He has a sixth sense for the box, a divining rod in his boots. He is a showman down to his bootlaces, a headline act.

Fermin Lopez.why: Fermin Lopez only pulls the trigger when the net is begging for it! He has a cannon for a right foot and loves to fire it. And he gets on the end of everything, as if the ball is on a string.

Endrick.why: Endrick has a cannon for a right foot and loves to fire it! He has been robbed blind by goalkeepers and the debt is piling up. He does not need the full ninety to start a riot.

Yan Diomande.why: Yan Diomande is on a tear, and the nets are trembling! He packs his minutes with mischief and menace. And he makes every shot count, not a single one thrown away.

Jude Bellingham.why: Jude Bellingham never wastes a bullet, every shot a love letter to the net! He packs his minutes with mischief and menace. And he plays with pure joy, a kid in the park in a grown man's kit.

Brian Farinas.why: Brian Farinas is a law unto himself, and the law is pure entertainment! He is pure theatre in a pair of boots, a matinee idol.

Denis Bouanga.why: Denis Bouanga shoots first and asks questions later, gloriously greedy! He lives in the six-yard box, pays no rent and eats all the biscuits. He shoots like a sniper on a rooftop, patient and deadly.

Heung-min Son.why: Heung-min Son never stops shooting, bless his thunderous boots! He sniffs out chances like a truffle pig in a Tuscan forest. He is box office, the kind of player who makes you spill your tea.

Jeremy Ebobisse.why: Jeremy Ebobisse waits for the moment like a heron over a still pond! He is always where the ball drops, as if he wrote the script. He makes forty thousand people lean forward in their seats.

Brady Scott.why: Brady Scott is a puzzle with a wicked grin, and nobody has the lid of the box! He plays with a twinkle in his eye and mischief in his feet.

Joao Klauss.why: Joao Klauss waits for the moment like a heron over a still pond! He will have a dig from the car park, the corner flag, the tunnel. He is a fox in the henhouse with his napkin already tucked in.

Kyogo Furuhashi.why: Kyogo Furuhashi has goals in the post and the postman is on his bike! He is a showman down to his bootlaces, a headline act.

Armindo Sieb.why: Armindo Sieb gets on the end of everything, as if the ball is on a string! He keeps the goalkeeper busier than a one-armed juggler. And he is a spark looking for a fuse, and the box is full of them.

Tommy Mihalic.why: Tommy Mihalic brings the fireworks, the confetti and the brass band!

Leo Walta.why: Leo Walta lives with his finger on the trigger and a grin on his face! He makes forty thousand people lean forward in their seats.

Tyler Boyd.why: Tyler Boyd is a showman down to his bootlaces, a headline act!

Thayllon Rebelo.why: Thayllon Rebelo is a mystery wrapped in an enigma wrapped in a gorgeous pair of boots! He is pure theatre in a pair of boots, a matinee idol.

Joseph Paintsil.why: Joseph Paintsil is a fox in the henhouse with his napkin already tucked in! He waits for the moment like a heron over a still pond. And he could light up a wet Tuesday in a car park.

Hirving Lozano.why: Hirving Lozano lives with his finger on the trigger and a grin on his face! He is always where the ball drops, as if he wrote the script. He could light up a wet Tuesday in a car park.

Jacob Shaffelburg.why: Jacob Shaffelburg has magic in his boots and mischief in his eyes!

Marco Reus.why: Marco Reus only pulls the trigger when the net is begging for it! He makes forty thousand people lean forward in their seats.

tot.name: Back of the Net

tlegs.label: Venezia to score
tlegs.why: Venezia are not the favourites here, but one goal from them is the likeliest thing on the card. Their finishing has been running behind their chances, which is exactly when the goals come.

tlegs.label: Both teams to score
tlegs.why: Liverpool and Brighton & Hove Albion both have the tools to make the other side pay. One of these defences has been getting away with it lately, and that rarely lasts.

tlegs.label: Udinese to score
tlegs.why: Udinese only have to get on the board once, and they have been knocking on the door. AC Milan have conceded less than their chances deserve lately, and that evens out.

tlegs.label: Atalanta over 1.5 goals
tlegs.why: Expect Atalanta to make Frosinone work for every minute. Frosinone have been living a charmed life at the back, and charms wear off.

tot.note: Venezia are not the favourites here, but one goal from them is the likeliest thing on the card. Their finishing has been running behind their chances, which is exactly when the goals come. Liverpool and Brighton & Hove Albion both have the tools to make the other side pay. One of these defences has been getting away with it lately, and that rarely lasts. Udinese only have to get on the board once, and they have been knocking on the door. AC Milan have conceded less than their chances deserve lately, and that evens out. Expect Atalanta to make Frosinone work for every minute. Frosinone have been living a charmed life at the back, and charms wear off.
